item.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.

item.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has paused new data center development until an audit has been completed.

item.title: Walmart completes its acquisition of TV advertising company Vibe.co
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The acquisition, which was first announced in June, brings Vibe.co into Walmart Connect, Walmart's connected TV advertising platform.

item.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane, Russell Brandom
item.description: An analysis of the last seven years of Tesla earnings calls shows just little attention Musk pays to Tesla's car business.

item.title: Host a Side Event during TechCrunch Founder Summit Week in Boston
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Want to tap into the energy of 1,100+ startup founders, investors, and tech leaders descending on Boston for the Founder Summit 2026 on June 9? Host your own Side Event during “Founder Summit Week,” happening June 4-10!

item.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Apple says its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI has widened. In a new court filing, Apple claims additional former staff may have retained or accessed confidential information.

item.title: Spotify now has over 300M subscribers
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Notably, the company saw its subscriber base swell by 9% in the second quarter despite raising prices in several regions this year.

item.title: India moves to give its instant payments network a business model
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The legislation lays the groundwork for a potential overhaul of India's zero-merchant-discount-rate regime, under which businesses have not paid fees to accept UPI payments since 2020.

item.title: Is the future of data centers portable? Runware builds a pod to find out
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: On Tuesday, AI infrastructure company Runware announced the launch of its own modular data center called Sonic Inference Pod.

item.title: EON wants to move the data superhighway from ocean fiber to space lasers
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Endeavour Optical Networks is planning to launch the fastest space laser communications system yet built.

item.title: Bending Spoons to buy Airtable for $1.28B
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: At its peak in 2021, Airtable was valued at over $11 billion, but earlier this year, its shares were said to be trading on the secondary markets at a valuation of $4 billion.

item.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: After a quarter that delivered $1 billion in profit, Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Monday once again warned that AI frontier labs are too untrustworthy for enterprises.

item.title: Snap CEO sidesteps Specs preorder questions on Q2 earnings call
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: When asked about product-market fit, Spiegel said he believes mass-market consumer adoption won't occur until the end of the decade.

item.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.

item.title: Who’s legally to blame for Anthropic and OpenAI’s autonomous AI hacks? It’s complicated
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai, Zack Whittaker
item.description: OpenAI and Anthropic admitted that their unreleased AI models escaped their sandboxes and hacked several companies in unprecedented cyberattacks. Who is legally to blame? Should prosecutors charge the two AI frontier labs? Can victims sue them? We spoke to lawyers who specialize in computer hacking laws to find out.

item.title: Design Arena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Design Arena is used by 5.3 million people around the world, providing critical human evaluations to frontier labs.

item.title: Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: OpenAI’s first-ever influencer brand trip is sparking online backlash as tensions over the use of AI continue.

item.title: Apple challenges UK government’s latest demand for iCloud backdoor: report
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: Apple has appealed a new legal demand by the U.K. government, which critics say could threaten the privacy rights of users all over the world.

item.title: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Apple’s long-awaited AI overhaul finally makes Siri the assistant it was always supposed to be. Yet it arrives at a moment when simply being a capable AI assistant no longer feels revolutionary.

item.title: Outernet turns your saved posts into real-world adventures
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Founded by the creators of viral offline events like San Francisco’s citywide scavenger hunt Pursuit, Outernet's app helps users save places and events they discover online, then nudges them to actually go.
